svg.aria-label: Disease Prediction: Predicts 41 diseases from 132 symptoms with a tree ensemble and explains every result with SHAP. Pipeline: BUILD, HARDEN, DEPLOY, LIVE complete. Hardened with CORS locked to frontend, health checks, PDF reports. Stack: FastAPI · scikit-learn · SHAP.
